text:
emma: Heads up — docs PR #1257 (migration guide + SDK snippet) is ready for review. We need approvals by EOD Wed to hit the v1.8 release cutoff on Thu. Preview: https://preview.redwood.com/pr-1257

raj: Quick q — PR updates /v1.8/migration.md and adds redirects for the old paths. If we merge before infra redirects are live will external links 404? cc @infra

maya: CI preview shows build passed but there was one broken link to the python SDK snippet I fixed in a commit. Also FYI the example output changes if feature flag `new-split-tokenization` is enabled — might affect the migration examples.

ci-bot: Docs preview ready: https://preview.redwood.com/pr-1257/preview — build: passed, warnings: 1 (link at line ~42). Snippet linter: failing -> fixed in latest commit.

lee: Can someone take a11y/reviewer? @maria?

maria: I can do a review now. About redirects: infra is slotted to land redirect PR next Tue. If docs merge earlier we may get 404s for old links — would prefer to gate docs to avoid broken external links.

emma: Two options then: A) hold docs merge until infra redirect lands, or B) merge into /latest with a top banner and backport to /v1.8 after redirect. Thoughts?

raj: Option A is safer for public links. Option B could confuse search/links and leaks v1.8 content under /latest early.

maya: If we want to merge before redirects, we could add this banner at top: `Note: This page is part of the upcoming v1.8 release. Some links will be live after 2027-01-14.` Not ideal but workable.

emma: We need approvals regardless. @maria and @lee please review ASAP. If both approve by 17:00 UTC Wed we can coordinate with infra to land redirects before Thu night. If not, we'll move the PR to `v1.8-staging` and cut final merge during the cutover window.

lee: Will do quick pass now, will approve if no major issues.

maria: Reviewed — left two nit comments about fenced code formatting and an extra trailing backtick in the JS snippet. Approve pending those edits.

emma: Fixed the code fences and trailing backtick, pushed a small patch. CI preview refreshed. @ci-bot please re-run snippet linter.

ci-bot: Snippet linter: passed. All checks green. Preview updated: https://preview.redwood.com/pr-1257/preview

maya: Also bumped the SDK snippet to client v0.12 and added a short compatibility note. We should sync with release-notes so examples match final shipped client.

raj: I'll add an item to the release notes (docs + SDK snippet). Also pinging FF team: @alex-ff — is the feature flag rollout schedule still the same? If FF changes, migration output examples might be out of date.

alex-ff: Feature flag `new-split-tokenization` rollout: 10% ramp Wed 18:00 UTC, full rollout Thu 02:00 UTC. If docs must reflect post-FF output, we should merge after full rollout. Otherwise we need a note about differences.

emma: Plan: gate merge until either (1) infra redirect PR is merged OR (2) full FF rollout completes — whichever happens first. If infra redirect lands earlier we will merge immediately and I will follow up on any residual link issues. If FF goes full first, we'll merge after Thu 02:00 UTC. I'll set a calendar reminder and notify release lead. :thumbsup:

lee: Sounds good. I added a merge window to the release calendar for Thu 03:00 UTC and set myself as moderator.

release-bot: Scheduled docs merge window: Thu 03:00 UTC | Target: v1.8 | Moderator: emma | PR: #1257

emma: Thanks all — I’ll post a final status update when infra or FF signals are green. If anything changes ping me in this thread.
